title: Serpinh1 promotes fracture healing by enhancing osteogenesis via activation of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
authors: Tu, Zhehui; Xu, Chenchen; Zhu, Yuanxin; Li, Yiqiang; Xu, Hongwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Serpinh1通过Wnt/β-catenin通路促进骨折愈合和成骨分化，属于纯湿实验和信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The process of fracture healing encompasses tightly regulated cellular and molecular interactions. However, the precise regulatory mechanisms that orchestrate osteogenesis during bone regeneration remain unclear. METHODS: Fracture healing-related key genes were identified by integrating transcriptomic datasets (GSE157460 and GSE152677) with four machine learning algorithms. Gain- and loss-of-function experiments were performed by inducing serine (or cysteine) peptidase inhibitor, clade H, member 1 (Serpinh1) overexpression in murine fracture sites and mouse bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (mBMSCs), and by siRNA-mediated Serpinh1 knockdown in mBMSCs. Hematoxylin and eosin staining, Masson's trichrome staining, Western blot, quantitative real-time PCR, Alizarin Red S staining, alkaline phosphatase activity assay, and TOP/FOP luciferase reporter assay, were used to evaluate callus formation, osteogenic differentiation, and extracellular matrix remodeling. RESULTS: Four key genes, including biglycan (Bgn), collagen, type XI, alpha 1(Col11a1), collagen, type V, alpha 1 (Col5a1), and Serpinh1 were upregulated in the mouse model of fracture healing. In the murine fracture model, Serpinh1 overexpression promoted fracture healing, collagen deposition, and osteogenic marker expression. In mBMSCs, Serpinh1 overexpression enhanced the expression of osteogenesis-related proteins, increased mineralized nodule formation, and elevated alkaline phosphatase staining and activity, whereas Serpinh1 knockdown exerted the opposite effects. Mechanistically, Serpinh1 activated the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, and its pro-osteogenic effects were markedly abolished by methyl 3-[(4-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]amino-benzoate, a specific inhibitor of beta-catenin. CONCLUSION: Serpinh1 promotes fracture healing by enhancing osteogenic differentiation via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, suggesting that it may serve as a potential therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨折愈合过程涉及细胞和分子相互作用的严格调控。然而，在骨再生过程中协调成骨作用的确切调控机制仍不清楚。方法：通过整合转录组数据集（GSE157460和GSE152677）与四种机器学习算法，鉴定了骨折愈合相关的关键基因。通过在小鼠骨折部位和小鼠骨髓间充质干细胞（mBMSCs）中诱导丝氨酸（或半胱氨酸）肽酶抑制剂、clade H、成员1（Serpinh1）过表达，以及在mBMSCs中通过siRNA介导的Serpinh1敲低，进行了功能获得和功能丧失实验。使用苏木精和伊红染色、Masson三色染色、Western blot、定量实时PCR、茜素红S染色、碱性磷酸酶活性测定和TOP/FOP荧光素酶报告基因测定，评估了骨痂形成、成骨分化和细胞外基质重塑。结果：在小鼠骨折愈合模型中，包括双糖链蛋白聚糖（Bgn）、XI型胶原α1（Col11a1）、V型胶原α1（Col5a1）和Serpinh1在内的四个关键基因表达上调。在小鼠骨折模型中，Serpinh1过表达促进了骨折愈合、胶原沉积和成骨标志物表达。在mBMSCs中，Serpinh1过表达增强了成骨相关蛋白的表达，增加了矿化结节形成，并提高了碱性磷酸酶染色和活性，而Serpinh1敲低则产生相反效果。机制上，Serpinh1激活了Wnt/β-catenin通路，其促成骨作用被β-catenin特异性抑制剂甲基3-[(4-甲基苯基)磺酰基]氨基苯甲酸酯显著消除。结论：Serpinh1通过Wnt/β-catenin信号通路增强成骨分化促进骨折愈合，提示其可能作为潜在的治疗靶点。
